usageNotes: Use this to clone an existing LXC container into a new container with a distinct VMID; the operation is asynchronous and returns a UPID task string that must be polled via the task API to confirm completion. For normal (non-template) containers a full disk copy is always performed, so ensure the target storage has sufficient free space before cloning. Cross-node cloning (via 'target') is only permitted when the source container resides on shared storage accessible to both nodes.

examples.summary: Full clone of container 110 to new container 200 on the same node, placed in pool 'clients'

tips: The return value is a UPID (e.g. 'UPID:pve01:...'). Poll GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to wait for the clone to finish before starting the new container.
Linked clones (full=false) are only possible when the source is a CT template; attempting them on a running or stopped regular container silently falls back to a full clone.
If you specify 'snapname', the clone is created from that snapshot's disk state rather than the current disk — useful for golden-image workflows.
Cross-node cloning requires the caller to also hold 'Datastore.AllocateSpace' on the target storage and 'SDN.Use' on any bridge the new container will use.
The 'bwlimit' parameter throttles disk I/O during the copy in KiB/s; leave it unset on lightly loaded nodes to let the storage layer use its configured default.
